name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
cues: Lie flat and hold the bar above your shoulders on straight arms
Tilt your upper arms slightly back toward your head
Bend only at the elbows to lower the bar behind your forehead
Keep your elbows from drifting wide

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-01 (bulk approval of every pending exercise). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Family review 2026-10-01 rated minor. review: Upper arm holds at 108-110 deg of elevation and the elbows stay narrow. The bar lowers behind the forehead to 111.5 deg of elbow flexion, the shallow end of the 110-135 band (the head is in the way). I moved the camera from az -115 to -95 because at -115 the raised upper arm hid most of the triceps at lockout. Now it reads through the whole rep. Margins are 6.5% or more, feet flat, head and back on the pad. | skeptic: No verified defect. Head rests on the pad (refute-close-706-head, all phases), feet flat, bar and plates clear the bench end, and in the front sheet the elbows stay narrow. Two things for the owner. (1) In the front sheet (refute-visual-front/figure-706-front.png) the thighs splay wide, with the feet near the cell edges (about x 90 and 390 of 480) and the knees about twice hip width. It looks sprawled next to a normal flat-bench foot position. (2) The stretch sits at 111.5 deg, the shallow end of the 110-135 band, and the hero camera moved from -115 to -95. These are accepted decisions, but together they give a weaker primary than a normal three-quarter view. Downgraded because I am not fully sure the leg splay reads as finished.
